By this harmonized proxy, The Name of the Wind has the lowest normalized words/day (~608), thus the slowest.

mistake_reason: After Assistant correctly identified 'Out of the Silent Planet' as the slowest by the requested metric (lowest words/day) at step 5, Orchestrator failed to recognize the termination condition and insisted on continued 'refinements' (step 6). This unnecessary continuation introduced a different proxy metric (pages/day and a pages→words normalization) and even altered durations/pages assumptions, ultimately producing a contradictory and wrong final answer ('The Name of the Wind'). This behavior exemplifies FM-1.5: Unaware of Termination Conditions—persisting beyond completion and changing criteria instead of stopping once the task's success condition was met.
